title: A New Way to look at Networking
summary: Van Jacobson's 2006 Google Tech Talk argues for rethinking networking around named data rather than host-to-host connections. He gives the history and the unsolved problems of the current internet architecture.
why: Recommended as the foundational talk on content-centric and named-data networking, and for its internet history stories.

quote.text: There's an old tech talk that got me out of the IP-shaped box a lot of us are trapped in
